summary: Image-level (full container) update orchestration, driven by the external composer-updater, plus curated release highlights in the update modal.
highlights: Adds image-level updates: releases that need a full container rebuild can now be applied from the Updates page, not just inline wheel swaps.
Pre-update backup and maintenance mode are handled automatically before the new image is pulled and started.
Update notes now show as short highlights instead of a long summary.
